preparation_script.file: original audit-chat preparation script; hash retained as provenance

vent.meaning: Current Smithsonian GVP Toba caldera reference coordinate; not a uniquely established YTT eruption vent.

input_contract.LogSD: omitted; no invented known measurement uncertainty
input_contract.Pseudo: omitted; excluded observations are absent, not pseudo constraints
input_contract.upper_limits: none; missing/held records are not non-detections

main45.definition: Principal 45-record input: all 43 nonblank audited fit_cm records plus N001/N002 primary YTT airfall beds at reported approximately 23 cm each. Approximate user-workbook coordinates remain explicitly qualified; surveyed positions unresolved.

main43.definition: Exclusion sensitivity: principal main45 minus N001/N002; identical to the original 43-record selection.

no_md16140.definition: Principal main45 minus N021-N025, five bioturbated MD161 additions; both Maninjau primary beds retained.

no_md16138.definition: main43 minus N021-N025, testing influence of five new bioturbated Mahanadi beds.

with_maninjau45.definition: Historical 45-record inclusion-sensitivity input, now numerically identical to principal main45; retained for old report provenance.

selection_manifest.csv_row_definition: 1-based physical CSV row, including header on row 1; matches repository row_ids before canonical ordering

range_handling: Use audited fit_cm point values unchanged. Reported low/high values mix ranges, alternate contacts and local variation; no distribution or LogSD is inferred.
spatial_dependence: No new weights or coordinate aggregation. Rehi/Ghoghara, Mahanadi/U1446, U1449/U1450, Arabian Sea cores and Maninjau sections include local clusters. Repository model and validation determine spatial treatment.
preserved_semantics: Chala is gross preserved-deposit thickness, not solid-glass equivalent.
RC14-37 uses observed 15 cm, not historical reconstructed approximately 20 cm.
Malawi assumed and illustrative equivalent values excluded.
Huguangyan has no validated thickness and is excluded.
All other blank fit_cm records excluded; no occurrence interval substituted.
N001/N002 are principal primary-fallout observations at approximately 23 cm using qualified approximate coordinates; source workbook blanks are preserved and explicit inclusion overrides recorded.
import_verification: Input CSVs and manifest recovered as complete ZIP entries with CRC checks, then verified against prior SHA-256 records. Original workbook downloaded separately; its SHA-256 matches the audit record.

selection_revision.reason: Include the two documented primary YTT airfall beds as qualified observations. Approximate coordinates are a location uncertainty, not evidence that the measured beds are non-primary. Retain without-Maninjau sensitivity.
selection_revision.thickness_qualification: Approximately 0.23 m in the inherited source audit; do not interpret 23 cm as exact measurement precision.
selection_revision.coordinate_qualification: User-workbook approximate coordinates retained; primary-source positions remain unresolved. Coordinate uncertainty is not propagated in model intervals.
selection_revision.evidence_scope: Existing audit cites section 3.3 and Figs. 2–3; publisher abstract independently confirms two underlying beds correlated with YTT. No new surveyed coordinates or measurement errors asserted.
